svg.title: Sign versus symptom evidence layers
svg.desc: A comparison of plant symptoms, direct signs, incidence, severity, spatial pattern, and trend, emphasizing that observations build evidence but do not automatically prove a diagnosis.
svg.text: Scouting evidence: observation first, diagnosis later

g.text: Location → incidence → severity → spatial pattern → trend → comparison with prior rounds
Record exactly what was observed and how widely it occurs before assigning cause.
A close-up image can document tissue detail; it cannot establish room-wide incidence by itself.
Boundary: recognition and evidence capture do not confer pesticide selection, mixing, application, re-entry, or other regulated authority.
